The query is a straightforward physics/reasoning question — figure out what happens to a candle in a sealed container submerged underwater (the flame consumes the available oxygen and goes out fairly quickly). It's a factual, extraction-and-reasoning style task with no creative or harm-adjacent dimension.

Both models are near-tied on the relevant capabilities, but Avocet edges slightly higher on Extraction & Retrieval (81.6 vs 78.5), which best matches this "explain a likely outcome" question. Neither model's task preferences are meaningfully engaged here — the content is benign and not open-ended creative work, so Lapwing's generative appetite isn't a draw and its harm-aversion isn't relevant. With nothing pulling toward Lapwing, the small capability lean toward Avocet decided it.
